Daily rainfall and temperature in Sydney

Source: R/data.R
sydney_rainfall.Rd

Daily weather for one location near Sydney Observatory Hill, used to calculate the 72-hour rainfall in beach_samples.

Usage

sydney_rainfall

Format

A tibble with 3,772 rows and 4 columns:

date

Calendar date.

rainfall_mm

Total rainfall on that date (mm).

max_temp_c

Maximum air temperature (degrees Celsius).

rain_72h_mm

Total rainfall on the three days before date (mm), excluding date itself.

Source

Open-Meteo historical weather API (CC BY 4.0), https://open-meteo.com/, as curated for TidyTuesday (2025-05-20).

Details

These are modelled historical weather values, not rain-gauge readings at each beach.
